title: Compressor
text: Compressor for boosted engines, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Calibrate Performance Maps} sets the calibrate tables with measured data, {Corrected mass flow rate table, mdot_corr_tbl} sets the lookup table array, {Efficiency table, eta_comp_tbl} sets the lookup table array, {Corrected speed breakpoints, w_corr_bpts1} sets the breakpoints vector, {Pressure ratio breakpoints, Pr_bpts2} sets the breakpoints vector, {Reference temperature, T_ref}, {Reference pressure, P_ref}, {Ideal gas constant, R} sets the constant and {Specific heat at constant pressure, cp}. Values come from the instance.
